## INSTRUCTION SET 1: INTAKE & BOOTSTRAP VERIFICATION

### 1.1 Root Directory Structure Validated
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Unpack `DARCH-prima.zip` complete
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Validate `DARCH-prima_serialized.txt` present and readable
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Source files extracted to repository root
- **Verification Flag:** `INTAKE_STRUCTURE_VALID`
- **If Failed:** Runner flags `DISCREPANCY_MISSING_SOURCE` → Jewels loops back

### 1.2 Framework Identification Confirmed
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `package.json` present and valid JSON
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Framework detected: Vite + React + TypeScript + TailwindCSS
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `vite.config.ts` present and ESM-compatible
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `tsconfig.json` present with correct target
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `tailwind.config.js` (or .ts) present
- **Verification Flag:** `FRAMEWORK_IDENTIFIED`
- **If Failed:** Runner flags `DISCREPANCY_FRAMEWORK_MISMATCH` → Jewels loops back

### 1.3 Dependencies Installed Successfully
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `npm install` executed with zero critical errors
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `node_modules/` directory populated (>50MB typical)
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** All package versions match `package-lock.json`
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** No peer dependency conflicts in install log
- **Verification Flag:** `DEPENDENCIES_INSTALLED`
- **If Failed:** Runner flags `DISCREPANCY_INSTALL_FAILED` → Jewels loops back
- **Evidence File:** `.checkpoints/1_3_npm_install_log.txt` (save output)

### 1.4 Build Succeeds
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** `npm run build` executed without errors
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Build output directory created (`dist/` or configured output)
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** No TypeScript compilation errors in build log
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** No Vite/ESM warnings in build output
- **Verification Flag:** `BUILD_SUCCESS`
- **If Failed:** Runner flags `DISCREPANCY_BUILD_FAILED` → Jewels loops back
- **Evidence File:** `.checkpoints/1_4_build_log.txt` (save output)

### 1.5 Documentation & Missing Items Recorded
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Environment variable requirements documented (none expected, confirm)
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Missing files or config issues logged
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** Deployment blockers identified and logged
- **Verification Flag:** `INTAKE_DOCUMENTED`
- **Evidence File:** `.checkpoints/1_5_intake_report.md`

### 1.6 INSTRUCTION SET 1 COMPLETE
- [ ] **Checkpoint:** All 5 sub-checkpoints passed
- [ ] **Terminal State:** `DONE_COMMITTED_LOCAL` or `DONE_PUSHED` (if defects found)
- [ ] **Commit Message:** `checkpoint: complete instruction-set-1-intake [#1.6]`

## RUNNER VERIFICATION SCHEDULE

**Scheduled Verification:** Every 30 minutes (or trigger on commit to repair branch)

```
CHECK: INTAKE_STRUCTURE_VALID
  └─ Verify: DARCH-prima files extracted
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/1_1_* files exist
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_MISSING_SOURCE

CHECK: FRAMEWORK_IDENTIFIED
  └─ Verify: package.json valid JSON
  └─ Verify: vite.config.ts ESM-compatible
  └─ Verify: tsconfig.json present
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_FRAMEWORK_MISMATCH

CHECK: DEPENDENCIES_INSTALLED
  └─ Verify: node_modules/ exists
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/1_3_npm_install_log.txt exists
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_INSTALL_FAILED

CHECK: BUILD_SUCCESS
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/1_4_build_log.txt exists
  └─ Verify: dist/ or configured output exists
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_BUILD_FAILED

CHECK: DEFECTS_INVENTORIED
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/2_1_defect_inventory.md exists
  └─ Verify: 6+ defects listed
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_INCOMPLETE_DEFECT_LIST

CHECK: REPAIRS_COMPLETED
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/2_4_repairs_log.md exists
  └─ Verify: 6 repairs documented
  └─ Verify: Each repair has Commit: SHA
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_REPAIR_INCOMPLETE

CHECK: BRANCH_PUSHED
  └─ Verify: Remote branch exists at origin/repair/versail-deployment-*
  └─ Verify: .checkpoints/3_2_push_log.txt exists
  └─ Verify: HEAD SHA matches PR branch
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_PUSH_FAILED

CHECK: PR_UPDATED_OR_CREATED
  └─ Verify: PR #1 (or new) exists and is OPEN
  └─ Verify: PR body includes repair summary
  └─ Verify: PR branch points to repair branch
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_PR_NOT_UPDATED

CHECK: RECEIPT_POSTED
  └─ Verify: PR contains handoff receipt
  └─ Verify: All 8 fields filled
  └─ Verify: NEXT_OWNER != blank
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_RECEIPT_MISSING

CHECK: HANDOFF_COMPLETE
  └─ Verify: All 4 instruction sets marked complete
  └─ Verify: Terminal state is DONE_PR_OPEN
  └─ Verify: Reviewer assigned or identified
  └─ If FAIL: Flag DISCREPANCY_HANDOFF_INCOMPLETE
```

## RUNNER DISCREPANCY FLAGS & RECOVERY

| Flag | Meaning | Jewels Action |
|------|---------|---------------|
| `DISCREPANCY_MISSING_SOURCE` | Source files not extracted | Loop back to 1.1; re-unpack |
| `DISCREPANCY_FRAMEWORK_MISMATCH` | Framework detection failed | Loop back to 1.2; verify config |
| `DISCREPANCY_INSTALL_FAILED` | npm install failed | Loop back to 1.3; debug deps |
| `DISCREPANCY_BUILD_FAILED` | Build did not succeed | Loop back to 1.4; fix errors |
| `DISCREPANCY_INCOMPLETE_DEFECT_LIST` | <6 defects found | Loop back to 2.1; search again |
| `DISCREPANCY_COMPILATION_ERRORS` | TypeScript/lint errors remain | Loop back to 2.2; fix errors |
| `DISCREPANCY_BLOCKER_UNRESOLVED` | Blocking issues not addressed | Loop back to 2.3; analyze |
| `DISCREPANCY_REPAIR_INCOMPLETE` | Not all repairs committed | Loop back to 2.4; complete repairs |
| `DISCREPANCY_REPAIRED_BUILD_FAILED` | Build fails after repairs | Loop back to 2.5; fix issues |
| `DISCREPANCY_UNCOMMITTED_CHANGES` | Uncommitted changes exist | Loop back to 3.1; commit all |
| `DISCREPANCY_PUSH_FAILED` | Remote push failed | Loop back to 3.2; retry push |
| `DISCREPANCY_PR_NOT_UPDATED` | PR not open or incomplete | Loop back to 3.3; create/update |
| `DISCREPANCY_INCOMPLETE_HANDOFF` | Handoff receipt missing fields | Loop back to 3.4 or 4.1; complete |
| `DISCREPANCY_RECEIPT_MISSING` | Receipt not posted to PR | Loop back to 4.1; post receipt |
| `DISCREPANCY_AUTHORITY_MISSING` | AGENTS.md not referenced | Loop back to 4.3; document |

## JEWELS HANDOFF LOOP MECHANISM

When Runner detects `DISCREPANCY_*`:

1. Runner flags the specific checkpoint
2. Runner updates `CHECKPOINTS.md` with ⚠️ icon
3. Runner posts issue comment or creates task: `@jewels Loop back to checkpoint X.Y: [REASON]`
4. Jewels re-enters at checkpoint X.Y (not from start of instruction set)
5. Jewels completes checkpoint and marks `[x]`
6. Jewels continues forward from there
7. Runner re-verifies on next scheduled run

---

**This system ensures continuous progress tracking, automated verification, and no stalled tasks.**
